text:
Omar Patel: Quick question — noticed staging pods don't see updated secrets until ~40-60s after ExternalSecret sync completes. Is that just the controller resync TTL or something else?

Rachel Ng: Could be the controller + kubelet cache for projected volumes. What controller are we running (kubernetes-client/external-secrets vs external-secrets/external-secrets)?

Omar Patel: external-secrets/external-secrets (latest helm chart from infra repo). Here's the ES manifest we use in staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: staging-api-creds
  annotations:
    infra.redwood.com/secret-ttl: "15s"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 60s
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-staging
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: staging-api-creds
    creationPolicy: Owner
  data:
    - secretKey: api_key
      remoteRef:
        key: secret/data/staging/service
        property: api_key
```

Kevin Li: Two things to check: 1) controller's `refreshInterval` vs the ExternalSecret `refreshInterval` and 2) the Pod's projected volume mount behavior — kubelet sometimes delays replacing files to avoid churn.

Maya Torres: Do we see any churn or permission errors in the controller logs? If the secret is updated in k8s but pods still read old file, that's kubelet. If k8s Secret isn't updated until later, it's controller timing.

Omar Patel: I checked: external-secret controller log shows the sync at 21:04:12 and k8s Secret created at 21:04:13, but the pod log still shows old value until 21:05:01.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Event: external-secrets-controller.v1.8.0 rolled to staging, 21:03:45 UTC

Rachel Ng: That matches kubelet behaviour — projected volume refresh can be slow-ish. Options: 1) switch pods to use `envFrom` (env var) instead of projected file mounts (env updates trigger faster restarts for containers that read env on start only), 2) reduce sync window and add annotation to force replace, or 3) use a sidecar that tails/watches the file and reloads app.

Kevin Li: For our use-case (hot API key rotation), I'd prefer making the secret update more immediate. Suggest adding the annotation `external-secrets.io/force-replace: "true"` (controller supports a replacement flag in our build), and reduce controller resync to 15s as a temporary measure. Also proposing a small Terraform change to the helm values in `modules/externalsecrets/values-staging.yaml`:
```hcl
# Terraform helm_release override
set {
  name  = "controller.refreshInterval"
  value = "15s"
}
set {
  name  = "controller.forceReplaceOnChange"
  value = "true"
}
```

Omar Patel: @Kevin can you open the TF PR? I'll run a smokecheck against staging after deploy.

Maya Torres: Also verify that the k8s Secret `resourceVersion` actually changes (should) and that rolling apps that cache the secret in memory handle refresh. Might need a small app-side watcher.

Kevin Li: Yep, will open PR with notes and a short rollout plan (canary on 10% of pods). I'll tag @Rachel for review on the helm value changes.

Rachel Ng: One more gotcha — don't set the interval too low cluster-wide; this controller hits Vault heavily. For staging ok but for prod we should route to a dedicated read-only Vault role or increase rate limits.

Omar Patel: Good call. For staging PR I'll scope to the `staging` helm release only and add a warning in the TF change.

infra-bot: [checklist] Action created: PR #4723 by Kevin Li -> "staging: reduce externalsecrets sync interval + enable forceReplace"

Omar Patel: Thanks — will run the post-deploy smokecheck and report back here with timestamps. :thumbsup:
